name.full: KLERQ deck builder for Microsoft 365 Copilot

description.short: Build client pitches from KLERQ content
description.full: Build a client presentation from what your firm already has in KLERQ: matters, work highlights, specialist bios, client references and texts from earlier pitches. Give a short brief, choose the content chapter by chapter, and the presentation is created in KLERQ and exported to PowerPoint through the firm's export templates.
